# Custom External Forces

| Force / Restraint | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| [add_allowed_plane_region](add_allowed_plane_region.ipynb) | Constraining atoms to a half-space bounded by a 3D plane using custom OpenMM forces |
| [add_allowed_z_region](add_allowed_z_region.ipynb) | Constraining atoms within a specific Z-coordinate slab using custom OpenMM forces |
| [add_constant_force](add_constant_force.ipynb) | Applying constant pulling or pushing force vectors to target atoms in OpenMM simulations |
| [add_forbidden_plane_region](add_forbidden_plane_region.ipynb) | Preventing atoms from entering a half-space bounded by a 3D plane in OpenMM |
| [add_forbidden_z_region](add_forbidden_z_region.ipynb) | Repelling atoms from entering a specific Z-coordinate slab in OpenMM simulations |
| [add_harmonic_bond_force](add_harmonic_bond_force.ipynb) | Adding harmonic bond interaction potentials between specific atom pairs in OpenMM |
| [add_plane_harmonic_restraint](add_plane_harmonic_restraint.ipynb) | Restraining atoms to lie on a 2D plane with harmonic potential wells in OpenMM |
| [add_point_harmonic_restraint](add_point_harmonic_restraint.ipynb) | Tethering atoms to target 3D Cartesian coordinates with harmonic positional restraints |
| [pin_atoms](pin_atoms.ipynb) | Freezing atom positions by setting their masses to zero in OpenMM simulation systems |
